facts.name: Rattlesnake Master
facts.notes: Yucca-like leaves and odd, spiky white globes that pollinators swarm in summer. A striking accent for a sunny spot.

sources.title: Michigan Wildflower Farm: Dryland species list
sources.note: Michigan seed grower; marks any species that is not native to Michigan.

sources.title: University of Illinois Extension: Deer Resistant Perennials
sources.note: Lists Rattlesnake Master (Eryngium) as deer resistant, while Rutgers rates Eryngium D. Because the two disagree, Rattlesnake Master and Sea Holly are left unrated.

companions.why: Combines well with other prairie plants, such as Liatris and little bluestem.
